{{Top|leg}}
The '''bakita crab''' was a species of [[Crab/Legends|crab]] native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. Although it was often considered as a [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]], the crab was in fact a [[Symbiosis/Legends|symbiotic]] organism. The bakita crab attached itself to many species of [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] and protected them from the [[water louse]].<ref name="TOR:VCED">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Visitor's Center Exploration Dome|Manaan}}</ref>
